name: feature-spotlight-stack
title: Feature Spotlight Stack
description: Stage product benefits as a focused vertical stack.
author: iPolloWork

ai.instructions: 逐一解释产品功能在同一任务中解决什么具体问题。

variables.label: Items (label::detail | ...)
variables.default: 上下文::先看到任务背景|批注::指出具体修改位置|确认::保留最终决定

variables.label: Supporting note
variables.default: 讲功能，不用空卡冒充产品截图

events.action: Explain supplied item 1 in narration order
Explain supplied item 2 in narration order
Explain supplied item 3 in narration order
Explain supplied item 4 in narration order

useWhen: 逐一解释产品功能在同一任务中解决什么具体问题。
avoidWhen: 不是操作演示或界面截图；真实画面用 media-hero，步骤用 product-steps。
This is a text-led treatment: not a measured chart, real screenshot, spatial camera or continuous simulation.

inputRules.title: One content-specific heading, at most 24 characters.
inputRules.items: 2–4 label::detail entries separated by |; each field at most 24 characters. 每项写真实功能及用户收益，不使用不存在的功能或未测量的性能提升。
inputRules.highlight: A real integer pointing to an existing item; it marks the final emphasis, not an inferred metric.
inputRules.note: One qualifier or source note, at most 40 characters. Retain uncertainty and evidence limitations.

cueBindings.step-1: Bind to the exact measured phrase introducing this item, never its text-length estimate.
cueBindings.step-2: Bind to the exact measured phrase introducing this item, never its text-length estimate.
cueBindings.step-3: Bind to the exact measured phrase introducing this item, never its text-length estimate.
cueBindings.step-4: Bind to the exact measured phrase introducing this item, never its text-length estimate.
cueBindings.resolve: Bind to the concluding phrase that resolves the shown relationship.

fallback.overflow: Split at a semantic boundary or choose a suitable recipe; never truncate or shrink text.
fallback.missingInput: Report the missing real content or evidence; do not substitute demo defaults.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind every active event to measured narration while preserving order, nonoverlap and a readable final hold.
fallback.inapplicable: Choose another proven native recipe. Under recipes-only policy report the capability gap; do not create custom graphics.

example.narration: 上下文，批注，确认，最后把它们放回同一个问题中理解。

acceptance: 每项能对应真实功能；文字说明不被宣称为真实产品演示。
Every active phrase changes its real visible target; forward and reverse seek reproduce the same state.
Chinese content fits at minimum and maximum capacity without cropped or overlapping labels.
This text-led treatment communicates its declared purpose, without pretending to render charts, real media or physical simulations.
